description: This file defines the 'Table1D' class, which extends 'TableWithData'. It manages a one-dimensional table structure used for data visualization or editing, including methods for populating table data, navigation (cursor movements), highlighting live data, and rendering table content. The class interacts with related classes such as 'Table2D' and 'Table3D', and handles axis-related behaviors and visual updates.

classes.name: Table1D
classes.description: Represents a 1-dimensional data table for visualization and interaction, supporting navigation, highlighting, and data population, with emphasis on axis management in multi-dimensional tables.

methods.name: setAxisParent
methods.description: Sets the parent table that represents the axis for this 1D table.

methods.name: getAxisParent
methods.description: Returns the parent Table object representing the axis.

methods.name: addStaticDataCell
methods.description: Adds a static DataCell to the data array if there's space.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table with data from a byte array input, updating layout and labels accordingly.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation indicating the table is 1D.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Handles cursor movement upward within the table, respecting axis context.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Handles cursor movement downward within the table, considering axis relationships.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Moves the cursor left within the table based on the current type.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Moves the cursor right within the table based on current context.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the current selection in the axis parent.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Highlights a specific cell, clearing previous selections, with differentiation for 3D/2D tables.

methods.name: getCellAsString
methods.description: Returns the string content of a cell at a specific index.

methods.name: highlightLiveData
methods.description: Highlights a cell based on live data value, updating visual trace and toolbar.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether live data highlighting is supported (returns false).

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Returns true indicating button state is considered selected.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this Table1D instance with another for equality based on axis type and data contents.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears live data tracing state in this and associated axis parent.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the table's label, delegating to the axis parent.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns the table data as a string buffer, formating static or dynamic data.
